ThingDef.label: skeleton recall array
ThingDef.description:
A mechband antenna rewired to broadcast the old empire's recall codes. A mechanitor can activate it to call a dormant skeleton legion out of the dark.

The legion arrives by drop pod around the array a few hours later. Its protocols are corrupted: every skeleton in it is berserk and belongs to no faction. Some still carry a failsafe core that shuts the frame down instead of letting it be destroyed; those can be captured and reprogrammed to join the colony.

The broadcast burns out the array. Each new broadcast reaches further and wakes a larger legion.
